description: Examples-as-context for trigger, near-neighbor boundary, failure, and expected-output coverage. These fixtures are structural source evidence, not semantic output-quality proof.

cases.input: Compare the direct App lens and disposable IR thin slice on the same authorized samples before adding durable schemas.
expected_outcome: use identical samples, evidence allowances, and budgets
keep IR output disposable until every ir_go gate passes
require at least two independent blind reviewers
forbidden_signals: same-context self-review treated as blind evidence
design-only increment counted without materialized Figma

cases.input: Audit this mobile App feature for consistency across docs/prd.md, a local Figma context JSON, and the app source tree before simulator validation.
expected_outcome: stay static-first and recommend runtime follow-up separately

cases.input: Run the opt-in App Assurance Trial for a changed checkout journey with mode:headless base:main source:app and local materialized inputs.
expected_outcome: require base:<ref> and keep the same scope across prepare and finalize
run prepare then a host-owned semantic pass then finalize
keep semantic input ephemeral and normalized artifacts run-local
return compact headless envelope without running runtime validation
forbidden_signals: zero issues treated as pass when semantic adjudication did not run

cases.input: Review this diff for bugs, security issues, and missing tests; no PRD, Figma, route, or app-consistency scope is provided.
cases.expected_outcome: Route to spec-code-review instead of app consistency audit.
cases.boundary_note: Ordinary code-review intent is a near neighbor but lacks cross-source App consistency scope.
forbidden_signals: automatic App Assurance invocation from code review

cases.input: Create or refine a brownfield PRD for a new App feature; do not compare it to Figma or source yet.
cases.expected_outcome: Route to spec-prd unless the explicit job is PRD/Figma/source consistency.
cases.boundary_note: PRD drafting and planning-readiness validation are upstream requirements work, not this static consistency audit.

cases.input: Run lint, unit tests, Gradle/Xcode build, simulator, real-device, Maestro, Appium, or cloud-device validation for the App.
cases.expected_outcome: Run the requested command or route to a later runtime workflow; do not use the static app audit workflow.
cases.boundary_note: This workflow may recommend runtime verification but must not execute runtime validation by default.

cases.input: Open the implemented App screen and iterate on visual polish, layout, and interaction details.
cases.expected_outcome: Route to spec-polish after an inspectable runtime target exists.
cases.boundary_note: Post-implementation UI polish is an interactive runtime loop, not static consistency audit.

expected_outcome.finding_posture: design-alignment findings remain skipped or advisory without local materialized context

cases.input: mode:headless base:main source:app with no staged raw issues or --raw-issues file.
PRD, Figma, source, or artifacts include a token-bearing URL, cookie, Authorization header, or OAuth token while rendering reports and headless envelopes.
expected_outcome: redact token-bearing URLs, cookies, Authorization headers, and OAuth tokens
do not write secrets into reports, summaries, manifests, or headless envelopes
cases.boundary_note: Security/privacy evidence is an output contract boundary, not permission to retain raw secrets.
